The '''Jedi Academy''' on [[Shedu Maad]] was established on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] after the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] and was still in use as of [[43 ABY]]. Although involved in the [[Battle of Uroro Station]], much of the academy was saved due to the efforts of [[Tahiri Veila]], as noted by Acting [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Kenth Hamner]].

Because the [[Jedi Coalition]] had originally used it as a hidden base on [[Shedu Maad]] during the war after they had evacuated their temporary [[Jedi Outpost|base]] on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], its location was still a closely guarded secret.

While the Jedi Order was reestablishing itself after the volatile war, they left the academy open while the Ossus facility was being repaired, due to the fact that all other academies had remained closed, to ensure the safety of the [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|younglings]]. After several Jedi contracted [[Force psychosis]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] smuggled four Jedi, [[Natua Wan]], [[Seff Hellin]], [[Yaqeel Saav'etu]], and [[Bazel Warv]] to the academy, to prevent them from being frozen in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]], like [[Jysella Horn|Jysella]] and [[Valin Horn]].
